content: If you upgraded to gen2 it might be a good idea to thread a zip tie through the unused screw hole to keep the longer wire in place.

Dumb tip to "touch something".
Static electricity is all about potential. Potential is relative.

Only thing you accomplish by touching "something grounded" is evening out the potential with that item.

That item is not the same as the fan electronics.
I dont get the warning about touching electronics here. The board does not have any active components. Its just two connectors.
